findings.details: Missing HTTP Headers: Content-Security-Policy, Strict-Transport-Security, X-Frame-Options
findings.remediation: Configure HTTP response headers in reverse proxy (Nginx/Cloudflare) or web framework middleware.

findings.details: Search query parameter reflects raw script markers in DOM context without escaping.
findings.remediation: Implement strict context-aware HTML entity encoding on search query outputs.

findings.issue: Raw SQL Concatenation in User Search
findings.message: User input directly interpolated into database query string.
findings.remediation: Replace string interpolation with parameterized db.query($1) placeholders.
